data.narrative:
Innoviz Technologies (INVZ) is a public-stage company operating in the Drones & Autonomous sector. The relevant peer universe comprises seven private companies in the same sector, including Waymo, Wayve, Zipline, Joby Aviation, and Nuro. No public comparables exist within the Drones & Autonomous space, and no same-stage or adjacent-stage private peers meet minimum clustering thresholds for reliable median analysis.

The Peer-Median method is not applicable to this valuation. The sector contains only seven private competitors total, and filtering by stage proximity or valuation tier yields fewer than three datapoints—the minimum required for meaningful median-based triangulation. Relying on an all-sector median would introduce excessive noise given the heterogeneity in business models, technology maturity, and capital requirements across autonomous systems companies.

This analysis cannot proceed to a supported valuation range without additional data. A credible triangulation would require either: (1) expansion of the comparable set to include adjacent sectors (e.g., robotics, advanced sensors) with sufficient same-stage or similar-tier depth; (2) application of alternative methods such as discounted cash flow or venture-based methods, which require revenue projections, margin assumptions, or fund-level data not provided here; or (3) direct transaction multiples from recent funding rounds in the peer set. The core uncertainty remains the absence of quantitative anchors suitable for public-company valuation in this nascent sector.
